entities.summary: Congress, a political institution in India during Economic Liberalization and Rise (2004–2014). Grew from India conducts Pokhran-II nuclear tests; Pakistan responds with its own tests and 1991 Reforms and IT Revolution. Led to the emergence of Right to Information Act and Mumbai terrorist attacks by Lashkar-e-Taiba kill 166 people.
